avis.titre: This product did not work for me.
avis.texte: I have normal skin, not overly sensitive. The cream smells pretty bad and it has caused a breakout. I'll be returning this.

The substance is still amazing but the non - pump bottle design doesn't allow any control of the distribution, which wastes product, and honestly it's just so clear you're not getting as much and paying more. I've been a loyal Blume customer since COVID and I'm pretty sure this is my last bottle. Pretty sad about it.
Love this product. Face feels so clean afterwards. It smells fresh, and a little goes a long way!

Love my Blume products! I start with daydreamer face wash, then meltdown oil, then milky fade, and finish with the meltdown gel cream. I have tried so many acne products over the years and these are the only ones that really work. Not to mention great customer service. I am a repeat customer!

avis.titre: Wanted to support a South Asian owned business but...
avis.texte: This cleanser, if you can even call it that, was disappointing. There's no lather. It feels like you're washing your face with lotion. It irritates my skin. And it doesn't remove makeup unless you use it more than once at a time.
This is so gentle and amazing! My skin was irritated and dry from overly harsh cleansers, and has felt much more nourished and calm ever since I swapped this in.
Very nourishing and fresh scented! Perfect second cleanser. Only wish they sold in a larger size and the pump tends to dispense an excess of product.
I love that my skin feels really clean and fresh after using this product
I have dry skin so I am hesitant about products and this always feels great when I apply it!

This is my go to product, I use this every night and it has helped my skin so much! I had really bad acne and this has helped with my little break outs as well! Such a good product, I will never stop buying this face wash

This was for my 26 yr old daughter who has struggled for years with acne and dark spots. I have for years tried to help her navigate and find the right skin care products. The acne and dark spots have played a big role in her self esteem. I am hoping so much that the products from Blume including the Daydreamer face wash will be the success tools she has been looking for. So far it has been good.

avis.titre: Absolutely love how my skin feels!
avis.texte: Absolutely love the way my skin feels after using this product. First time for me and will definitely buy again!

i rarely write reviews but this legit did nothing for my skin... it doesn't even lather in your hands. you could just not wash your face and get the exact same results. i gave it a solid 2 weeks to work and ended up breaking out more than usual, not like a reaction but i knew it wasn't doing anything. not sure if i got a bad batch or something but it absolutely did not work. wish i could get my money back.
Very happy with this purchase. Was drawn to it by using the meltdown oil (which is also amazing) and reading the reviews. Very happy with how gentle it is and my face feels soft and not dried out.

I wanted to start using a retinol product in my routine, so I had to change ALL my skincare to be able to do so with no reactions (chemical exfoliates, etc.) Decided to try Blume since it's clean ingredients, and I love it! My fave feels so soft after this cleanser. I use the acne oil and meltdown moisturizer too, and I've noticed a reduction in acne and redness. If I do get a pimple, it's gone quickly. Try this brand out!!! I've tried MANY, and I think I'll be sticking around this brand < 3

I use this as my second cleanse step aftet elf makeup removing balm. I have sensitive skin that tends to be dry and as I approach middle age I am very wary of foaming face washes- hence I use none! I dont even use shampoo except once a week. This stuff is like magic. I dont understand the low rating or poor reviews. It cleanses my skin so gently but thoroughly. 10/10 would recommend.

I love this face wash! It calms my face down so much. I notice a big difference both when I'm using it (positive) and when I run out (negative). I found it while pregnant and continue using it now while breastfeeding.

avis.titre: Love how soft it feels on my skin
avis.texte: I really like how creamy and smooth this goes on. Leaves my skin feeling very soft. I have tried moving away from harsh chemicals and this does the trick.
I love Daydreamer. This face wash works well for my oily/combination skin and I use it every day. Daydreamer smells good and it has a good, soft texture.
Perfect balance of a powerful and gentle cleanser. They way this product helps manage my sensitive adult acne-prone skin is chefs kiss superb.
I've worked in skincare for 15 years and this is probably in the top 5 worst face cleansers for me. I ended up saving it for the shower for morning cleanses.
I love the clean ingredients and the way my skin feels after using it.
So thankful I found this brand and this cleanser! The only thing that has helped clear my acne and make me feel confident in my skin.

I'm not sure how to rate this because I love the product, but the packaging has ruined it for me. I won't be ordering again until they offer larger bottles or refills that would be less wasteful and annoying to use. The dispenser leaves a lot of product at the bottom of the bottle and I spend over a week unscrewing the lid and tapping out the product. Even if I've bought a new bottle, I'm not about to throw away two weeks of cleanser in the old one just because the squirt dispenser isn't catching it. Throwing out plastic bottles all the time feels wasteful as well. I understand that the subscription option is attractive to companies and many people won't care, but after finishing my third bottle, I'm annoyed by the inconvenience of it all and won't be reordering. It's tiring to have to order things all the time or have to manage delaying the subscription because I'm not ready yet. It's a wonderful cleanser that my skin absolutely loves, but there's honestly a lot of other cleansers that are good enough for my skin and packaged in a way that suit my practical needs much better.

avis.titre: Final piece of my skincare puzzle
avis.texte: I am so glad I finally tried this face wash. I've been using meltdown for years, and I added milky fade this past year. I saw huge improvements in my hormonal acne with each one, and I finally tried daydreamer this past summer with IMMEDIATE results (and I kept waiting for the other shoe to drop because I couldn't quite believe the speed of improvement, but it's still going strong!). It's like it was the final piece of the puzzle for me, and I am still in disbelief that I've finally found a combination of products that works after over a decade of feeling like I was battling my own skin.
I love how refreshing and clean my face feels and I can also see all of the makeup that has been removed after washing.
I love this face wash! I have very sensitive skin and it does not irritate it and leaves it feeling clean and soft.

I first purchased this while pregnant, and I enjoy it so much I've continued using it postpartum. I like that it's safe, it calms and soothes my skin, and I definitely noticed a difference when I ran out and had to use a different product.
I love the gentle cleanser and I've had clear skin since starting this product line! Recommend them all
My favorite face wash. It is so creamy and smells great. Always leaves me feeling clean and fresh and super great on sensitive skin!

Having combo skin (more on the oily side) I had always opted for cleansers that stripped away all my natural oils to feel "clean" but little did I know back then that's the worst thing you can do for oily skin. Since I found Blume products, my skin has never looked better. I love how natural the ingredients are and no harsh chemicals are used. My face feels clean and supple, not stripped and dry like most cleansers. It creates a healthy balance and I have WAYYYY less breakouts than before. I used to have uncontrollable cystic acne around my chin that drastically improved after using this brand and now I rarely ever have them. If I do I use the Melt Down and it really helps. Battling oily skin by stripping away the oil is such a no go. I'm so happy I found this product and learned how to actually care for my skin. Please don't ever stop making this!! I'm already torn up that Stargirl is no longer available!
Beat face wash. Mild yet effective. I use it morning and night and it makes my skin clean and clear.
I love the smell! It makes my face so soft and really helps with the unwanted blemishes

We already know Blume makes a quality product but I'm a huge sucker for the smell of this lovely cleanser. While gently washing away the crud of the day, the scent transports me and makes me smile 😊 Just love it.
1st time to try this. Like the texture, slight fragrance & seems to cleanse without drying. Does feel a bit oily.

avis.titre: Not sure if it's my forever cleanser..
avis.texte: Smells lovely but I'm still getting used to its gentle nature...I'm used to foaming & this doesn't, but I do like it & I'm sticking with it for now.
I absolutely love this product, the fragrance is amazing, not too strong and just so pretty. It leaves my skin feeling so soft and refreshed but not completely stripped of moisture.

I bought this initially back in December 2022 because it had all 5 star reviews. It's probably one of the most useless face washes I've used (not to be dramatic 😂). It feels like just slides all over my face, is slimy, and never actually sets in...so my face never actually felt clean. I think I used it 4-5 times before I just gave up.

avis.titre: It works when combined with Whirl
avis.texte: I liked it when I had Whirl but without Whirl it dries out my face so I haven't been using it lately & probably wont purchase more unless I can first purchase Whirl.
Great cleanser! I truly love how gentle it is on my skin. It cleanses without leaving a stripping feeling. Great compact size for traveling as well.
It keeps my skin clean without drying it out. My skin hasn't been this clear in years!
I love how soft it makes my skin feel and how it is perfect for my sensitive skin.
I love how soft it makes my skin feel and how it is perfect for my sensitive skin.
The only face wash I use! I have sensitive skin and this face was is cleansing and hydrating at the same time. I love the creamy texture and natural ingredients. Definitely recommend!
The only face wash I use! I have sensitive skin and this face was is cleansing and hydrating at the same time. I love the creamy texture and natural ingredients. Definitely recommend!

avis.titre: Amazing face wash and my skin has never been softer!
avis.texte: It acts like a mosturizer as well and my skin has never felt softer!

avis.titre: Amazing face wash and my skin has never been softer!
avis.texte: It acts like a mosturizer as well and my skin has never felt softer!

I wanted to love this product, but it clearly did not really wash off my makeup because I broke out sooo bad using this face wash. I switched recently and within 3 days my skin is so much clearer. I have the whole line of products so hopefully the others begin to work better with a new face wash.

I really like this cleanser but hate the packaging. The small bottle lasts me less than a month and I only use 2 pumps per day (I use this at night and a different cleanser in the morning). Once the bottle is over half gone, it becomes impossible to pump out any more product so you end up taking out the pump and pounding the bottle into your palm for the next week until it's gone. I've been using this cleanser for a few years and really hoped they would have fixed this problem by now as many other reviewers have complained about the same thing.

This is the best face wash I've ever used, and I've used MANY. Prior to finding this I used cetaphil for years as pretty much the only cleanser that didn't strip my skin. It was fine. Blumes cleanser blows the competition out of the water. My face looks healthy, plump, well moisturized, it's a first, and I'm 39.

This is the best face wash I've ever used, and I've used MANY. Prior to finding this I used cetaphil for years as pretty much the only cleanser that didn't strip my skin. It was fine. Blumes cleanser blows the competition out of the water. My face looks healthy, plump, well moisturized, it's a first, and I'm 39.

I have oily, sensitive skin and hormonal acne. This face wash doesn't strip the oils from my face, causing oil over production. Combined with melt down, I'm acne free for the first time since puberty. This stuff is life changing!
This is a nice cleanser but it is not a face wash as described. Super bummed to receive the item and discover this.
My go to facial cleanser, I haven't used anything else on almost 2 years! Thanks Blume.
I double cleanse and used this after my oil cleanser. It didn't seem to do much. Felt like over priced cold cream.
The scent on this product is so overpowering. It also caused me to break out
I purchased this for my daughter's and they love it!! They also love the Meltdown, it helps with their blemishes. They swear by it and they love how clean their face feels with the cleanser.

avis.titre: I really wanted to like it!
avis.texte: After searching for a good cleanser, this one failed me as well. I read a good bit of the reviews and really wanted to like it. However, I have really sensitive skin and it made my skin feel like it was burning and I got red bumps all over. I must be reacting to one of the ingredients.

avis.titre: You won't regret this purchase WHATSOEVER!
avis.texte: This is the ultimate cleanser. I have never used a cleanser so creamy. It is the perfect way to end your day, getting rid of any dirt or grime, as well as nourishing, and moisturizing your face! Absolutely amazing

I love this face wash! It's creamy but doesn't leave my skin greasy, and it smells like something they would for a facial at a spa. The only downside is the size of the bottle. I wish they made a bigger size so I didn't have to repurchase as often.
This cream cleanser is so light and cleans every bit of makeup off (even eye makeup!) without leaving any residue or making skin oily. My skin is so healthy since finding BLUME
My teen daughter loves Blume products. They work well to help with acne and are not harsh and drying.

I currently use the oil, moisturizer and serum so I was super excited to use the cleanser. I have super oily skin so for the longest time I have used gel foaming cleansers. I was honestly a little skeptical when it came to this creamy cleanser since I felt like it wouldn't match my skin type but I was so wrong!! Yes, I did have to get used to the fact that it didn't foam and lather, but it leaves my face feeling so soft and not stripped. I have found that my face does not get as oily like it used to! So I will say that even though it may not seem like what you need, it's definitely worth it. I personally love the locking pump as well and can travel with it easily! Just more reasons to live Blume even more!!
It's the perfect skin prepping product! I've been using it in the mornings and it sets my skin for the entire day!

avis.titre: my skin has never felt better!
avis.texte: My skin has never been better! It goes on to your skin so smooth and leaves your skin feeling hydrated silky and soft, while cleansing it!

avis.titre: I'm 50 and I've tried them all
avis.texte: This is hands down the best face wash I've ever used in my life! I've tried everything . Literally. I cannot wait to stock up again and hope they come out with more products-- love their stuff!
This cleanser is lovely - goes on creamy, comes off very light and leaves my skin feeling fresh. You do still need to use a toner afterwards, as I've noticed it leaves some makeup behind.

avis.titre: "My Skin Loves Blume! Try it for Yourself!"
avis.texte: I really love this face wash. It's gentle and doesn't have a strong smell, and it, along with the Blume Melt Down, Milky Fade, and the Blume Buds, have helped me get my skin clear and to keep it clear. Thank you Blume!

My holy grail line of skincare. I have been using Blume products for years now and my skin has never looked better. I went from horrible cystic type acne all over my face and neck to virtually NEVER having a breakout. Daydreamer face wash is simply amazing. Cleanses the day away and leaves my skin happy and moisturized. I'm always recommending to others. The key to success is CONSISTENCY and if you are consistent with these products and your routine you will see amazing results!

I love everything about this cleanser. This consistency is amazing. I normally wouldn't use a creamy cleanser but this one is the best performing I have ever used. It feels luxurious while I use it and my face feels clean and hydrated. Highly recommend.

I love this cleanser! It smells so nice, very much like the Lush Vanishing Cream Moisturizer (if you've ever smelled that). It is a non-sudsy consistency, so it doesn't necessarily give me that "squeaky-clean" feeling, but it feels nice & gentle. I have skin that is sensitive to some medicated cleansers that have salicylic acid in them, so my skin tends to dry out and get irritated with some everyday cleansers. But not this one! This leaves my skin feeling nice & not stripped of its natural oils. The formula is really gentle. My skin has not been dry since using this. Will continue to use!
Gentle and removes makeup well. Leaves skin hydrated without feeling greasy.
Smells nice and cleans well too. I work in a factory and my face doesn't feel clean until I wash with this

This is my favourite face wash I've ever used. I have to be honest, I often skip washing my face at night but with this face wash I never do! The lotion like consistency is so nice and the scent is heavenly. Kind of smells like you're at a spa and is a very nice relaxing scent and step to add to your bedtime routine.

avis.titre: This is not a foaming cleanser but a creamy cleanser.
avis.texte: I purchased this in hopes of getting a regular face wash. This was not what I expected…I did however get a makeup remover that I enjoy greatly.
Bought for my teen and ore teen daughters to try, they love it! It's great for sensitive skin and keeping them blemish free!

at my 20s, I love stripping cleanser cos I have combo skin. But now i am in my mid 30s, I love cream cleansers. If you are also looking for a cream cleanser, this is a nice one! it cleans nicely without stripping and I love the subtle lavender scent. My only complaint is I wish they have a bigger bottle. ps: for cream cleansers, you need to use more products than a foaming cleanser(usually I use 2-3 pumps). and you need to double cleanse in the PM (that's like 6-9 pumps per day), thus a 4oz cream cleanser doesn't really last very long. given the price and how much product it has, I think the Philosophy Purity Cleanser(also a cream cleanser) has a much better value (32oz for MSRP$59 and they have BOGO a few times a year)

I have never experienced a face wash that left my skin so soft! Some days I want to skip moisturizing( I don't!) so that I can feel that softness for longer. Based on my experience with Daydreamer I am about to start trying all of their other products Good job Blume!

i love the blume products i've tried so far. this one was not for me though. i have decided i must not be a cream cleanser fan. i prefer a cleanser to lather and this one didn't for me. also there's a sliiight smell that im not super into maybe it's lavender (👎) im not sure. it doesn't break me out or leave me stripped but i don't think i would repurchase. reading the product information on here before reviewing i noticed it says to use 2 to 3 pumps at a time. that feels excessive to me ive been using 1. im not finished with my bottle i'll try using more and see if that makes a difference.
I've used many face washes through the years. Daydreamer is now my go to product and I get regular shipments to keep my skin in check. Finally a solution for my adult breakouts!
I use Daydreamer with Meltdown and Whirl, and the combination has really helped my acne. I also appreciate that it leaves my skin feeling moisturized instead of dried out.

I cannot say which of the trio is really doing the trick for my 18 yr old son with acne, but together they are helping to get it under control. He had been on an antibiotic for the year and we did not see much improvement. Not wanting to be on an oral medication/antibiotic of so long, we discontinued and tried topical strategies. This was the latest and last and we are sticking with it as we are seeing positive results.
Leaves my skin really soft and doesn't strip it. It came as a gift but I'll be getting more

avis.titre: Feels like you're washing your face with a lavender cloud!
avis.texte: Feels like you're washing your face with a lavender cloud! Super gentle and soothing, no dryness.

avis.titre: Hormonal acne is terrified of this cleanser!
avis.texte: I struggle with hormonal acne and this face wash combined with the oil has been a game changer. I tried all the crazy systems but was looking for something simpler because I noticed the less and more gentle the products were, the better my skin reacted on the surface. Of course, I can't help the monthly break outs, but this cleanser with the oil keep them under control a little bit which is all I can ask for. I did start with the oil alone (using with another gentle wash) and the face wash came in a mystery bundle. That's when I decided to finally bite the bullet and get a subscription (which, to me, is the lucrative option!) so if you think this wash is a little pricey, I probably use a bottle in just under a month, washing twice a day with one pump each time. So the subscription is really the way to go!!
My skin is calmer and less oily than it has ever been. Daydreamer cleans so gently. I love the smell too.

avis.titre: Can't Decide If I Like It Or Not
avis.texte: First I'm surprised by all the comments about the scent- it smells lotion-y if that makes sense but I didn't find it overpowering. I have normal to dry skin and for me it leaves my skin feeling kind of tight/stripped. My other cleanser (Glow Recipe Blueberry Bounce) makes my skin feel so soft and hydrated. I did also notice there was still some makeup coming off on my towel after using this, which was disappointing. But I will say that looking at my skin in the mirror after using it, my skin did look very clear and tight and clean and smooth, which I like. So as I said, I'm torn lol.
I love the face wash overall. I don't like that it's so hard to get to the product at the bottom, it's such a waste.
This is actually the best product ever. This with the combination of the meltdown is a perfect combo to clear up your face!
Another wonderful find!!! Blume doesn't disappoint either. My skin feels amazing after one use.

This face wash leaves my skin so soft and feeling so clean! I've always used wash that has salicylic acid or exfoliation to combat adult acne, but tried this on a whim and I love it, and so does my skin. There's no tightness or drying and my skin is even healthier.
I love this face wash cream! It leaves my skin dewey and moist when I use it to take my make up off at night. I also like the fact that I can now pick it up at my local Ulta Beauty.
The Daydreamer face wash is amazing. It has a nice scent and is super gentle on my sensitive skin.

I really like this cleanser! I have not experienced breakouts and I love the texture, the scent and it has cleaned by face quite well! Don't ever stop making this. I will surely repurchase it once I get out of my self imposed skin care ban haha.

avis.titre: Stop using plastic packaging for products made with Essentia
avis.texte: Overall I love the product! But I can't give this 5 stars! PLEASE STOP USING PLASTIC!! Plastic and Essential Oils do not work work together and it ruins the product! Plastic breaks down the natural properties in essential oils, and the plastic also absorbs the scent! I have a newer bottle of the cleanser and it's already ruined the scent of the essential oils. I'm basically cleansing my face with something that smells like plastic and bad potpourri now. Please switch to glass. I probably won't be buying this again until the packaging issue is addressed! This goes for all the products… essential oils in plastic will ruin all of the products within a few months!! It becomes a waste of money because of it.

I've for so many years dealt with acne and have spent thousands of dollars on products that didn't work. My skin is sensitive and Daydreamer Face wash hasn't broke my face out. It cleans and leaves my face bright. I've only been using it for a few days and can see a differene in my pores.

avis.titre: A great way to erase the day!
avis.texte: I feel like this really gets my face clean! Deep into my pores clean!
I've been using this for over a year now and I love it! I have dry sensitive skin and it works great!

This is a wonderful cleanser. After discovering that oil free cleansers actually make my oily skin worse I've been looking for something more hydrating and this does the trick. The only real problem is the bottle is so small and there's product at the bottom you can't get to.

This is good stuff! After trying a ton of different products including prescriptions, Curology, and Differin, THIS cleared up my daughter's skin without drying it out. I wish it came in a bigger bottle!

avis.titre: Didn't do much or last long
avis.texte: First off this bottle is tiny, and since it's a cream cleanser I feel like I need a lot to cover everything. The bottle lasted a couple weeks maybe. Also noticed no difference whatsoever in my skin, nor did it feel as clean afterwards as with any other cleanser I've used. Wouldn't recommend

avis.titre: Loved the first bottle second bottle was gritty
avis.texte: I have super sensitive acne prone skin. The first bottle of this was amazing. So hydrating without cause if any breakouts. However, the second bottle I got had a weird gritty texture. Not sure if I will buy it again.
I've struggled to find a skin care regimen that isn't harsh with my sensitive skin. This face wash is super mild and great for sensitive skin! Leaves your skin feeling soft and glowy!
